column1: # Functions of EV Nova.exe linked from the CodeWarrior install's MSL_All_x86.lib (MSL 9.0.3, the pinned 418 install),
# not compiled from sources/. The library is NOT committed: tools/vendorlinked.py reads it from the compiler install
# One row per exe function with no // FUNCTION: marker; tools/vendorlinked.py verifies each against the exe and the image.
# Rows whose code is byte-identical to other library functions list those as member:symbol aliases (column 7): the exe
# holds one of them and the bytes cannot say which; the callers' relocations decide where they can.
